field.label: Address
field.help: Upstream DNS server address. Supports UDP, TCP, DoH, DoT protocols. Examples: udp://8.8.8.8, https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query

field.label: Trusted
field.help: Whether to trust the results returned by this upstream (for IP optimization scenarios)

field.label: Detour
field.help: Specify traffic detour label (such as through proxy)

field.label: Bootstrap
field.help: DNS address list for resolving DoH/DoT domain names

field.label: Domain
field.help: Limit this upstream to only handle requests for a specific domain

field.label: Enable HTTP/3
field.help: Whether to enable HTTP/3 (only valid for DoH)
